# FND-04: Trend results (finding F2) — PRELIMINARY

Generated by `python -m pipeline.run.trend` from `second-sight-data/bundle/monthly_<aoi>.json`;
full numbers in `second-sight-data/derived/trend.json` (not committed).

## Method

- Annual totals 2001-2025 (25 years; all 12 months present through 2025 in the bundle).
- Three series: **naive** stitch (`A_raw` through 2011, then `V_raw` SNPP), **summed** (`A_raw + V_raw`),
  **fair** (`H`, harmonized on the MODIS scale). `H_lo`/`H_hi` series reported as a band check.
- Theil-Sen slope with 95% CI, expressed as % of the 25-year mean per year.
- Modified Mann-Kendall test (Hamed & Rao 1998 autocorrelation-corrected variance), own implementation
  (no pymannkendall dependency), p two-sided.
- Window comparisons: 2019-23 vs 2003-07 (w1) and 2021-25 vs 2001-05 (w2), % change of mean annual total.
- ENSO sensitivity: El Nino years 2002/2004/2006/2009/2015/2019/2023 excluded (18 years left).
- **M1/M2 refit sensitivity: skipped** (not wired in time; only the `H_lo`/`H_hi` band was checked).
  Sign labels: "increase"/"decrease" = 95% CI excludes 0; otherwise "CI spans 0".

| Kalimantan | **fair** | **-4.2 [-9.7, -1.4]** | 0.006 | -5.2 [-8.2, -1.2] | <0.001 | -64% | -74% |

| Sulawesi | **fair** | **-4.1 [-6.9, -1.2]** | 0.007 | -4.9 [-7.1, -1.4] | 0.010 | -58% | -74% |

| Java-Nusa Tenggara-Bali-Maluku | **fair** | **-3.0 [-5.1, -0.1]** | 0.034 | -3.1 [-5.5, -0.1] | 0.041 | -29% | -49% |

Summed series behaves like naive (IDN +2.1%/yr, w1 +136%). `H_lo`/`H_hi` give the same sign and
near-identical slopes as `H` in every AOI (e.g. IDN -4.4 / -4.4 %/yr).

## What is robust

- **Sign of the fair trend is negative in all 6 AOIs**, under all-years, El Nino excluded, and the
  `H_lo`/`H_hi` band. The 95% CI excludes zero for IDN, Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi and JNBM
  in every variant; for **Papua the CI spans zero** (downward but not significant).
- The F2 contrast holds at national scale: naive stitch shows about **+98%** (w1) / +64% (w2),
  fair scale shows about **-63%** (w1) / -73% (w2). The naive upward slope itself is not
  significant for IDN (CI spans 0); the naive rise is mainly the 2012 sensor step, not a trend.
- Not tested: M1/M2 calibration refits, ONI regression adjustment (exclusion only), autocorrelation
  beyond Hamed-Rao, uncertainty from the calibration itself beyond the `H_lo`/`H_hi` band.

## What this does not say

These are descriptive statistics of satellite active-fire detections. Nothing here tests or
attributes the decline to any policy (moratorium, BRG/peat restoration, enforcement) or to land-use
change, and detection counts are not burned area or emissions.
